gpu.prompt:
Please install the GPU inference backend (whisper.cpp) for the Local Speech Service, entirely on this machine:
1. Service directory: __DIR__ (it should contain stt_server.py).
2. Detect the GPU first: NVIDIA -> CUDA backend; AMD / Intel -> Vulkan backend.
3. CUDA: download the official Windows CUDA prebuilt package from the whisper.cpp GitHub releases (whisper-cublas-*-x64.zip) and extract it into <service dir>\whisper\backends\cuda\ (whisper-cli.exe and DLLs placed flat in that folder). Note the official package lacks cuBLAS: add cublas64_*.dll and cublasLt64_*.dll (extractable from the PyPI nvidia-cublas-cu11/cu12 wheels), otherwise it silently falls back to CPU.
4. Vulkan: no official Windows prebuilt package; build locally with cmake -DGGML_VULKAN=ON (requires the Vulkan SDK) and place the artifacts flat into whisper\backends\vulkan\.
5. Afterwards restart the service (panel Restart button) and verify via http://127.0.0.1:__PORT__/backends that the backend shows installed and passes probing (the CUDA0 / Vulkan0 device marker must appear).
hint.custom: Any ggml model URL (.bin). It appears in the Active model dropdown once downloaded.
hint.modelPick: Switching the model restarts the service; while stopped the choice is only saved.
hint.modelEmpty: Start the service to pick an installed ggml model here.
hint.catalogOffline: Start the service to download models here.
hint.modelNote: Models are saved under whisper/ in the service directory. When the proxy field is blank, Snow App's own proxy setting is used automatically.
hint.dir: Directory containing stt_server.py. Leave empty to use the copy shipped with the plugin; the CPU whisper runtime downloads automatically on first start.
hint.blocked: The plugin could not reach the loopback endpoint. Check whether the app build allows local HTTP requests from plugins.
hint.start: Start runs python stt_server.py in the background; a resident whisper-server is launched on demand so the model is loaded only once.
note.title: About
note.body: This panel starts / stops / restarts the local whisper.cpp transcription service and manages its models. It only runs the service; voice input and read-aloud are handled by the companion client script. Speech recognition runs entirely on this machine.
